title: Privacy-safe support bundle — failure and forbidden-data evidence
summary: Evidence that the privacy scanner catches forbidden data in diagnostic output, that hex redaction prevents full hash exposure, that migration detection correctly identifies old install artifacts, and that the bundle creation rejects content carrying biometric terms.

forbidden_term_in_diagnostic_output.method: PrivacyScanner.scan() receives strings containing 'embedding', 'template', 'pixel' and must return ForbiddenTerm error

forbidden_term_frame_crop_threshold_nonc.method: PrivacyScanner.scan() receives strings containing 'frame', 'crop', 'threshold', 'nonce' and must return ForbiddenTerm error

forbidden_term_score.method: PrivacyScanner.scan() receives 'match score=0.8723 accepted' — 'score' is now a forbidden term, caught as ForbiddenTerm (previously caught as RawScore)

hex_sequence_in_content.method: PrivacyScanner.scan() receives '0xdeadbeefcafef00d' (0x + 8+ hex) and 'aaaa...4444' (32+ contiguous hex) — both rejected

pem_key_marker_in_content.method: PrivacyScanner.scan() receives '-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----' — rejected as key material

bundle_rejects_biometric_term.method: Create a config with vid_pid='embedding-leak', run doctor, attempt bundle creation — must fail with PrivacyError::ForbiddenTerm

bundle_rejects_unfiltered_log.method: BundleInfo.log_excerpts contains 'embedding leaked into unfiltered log' — bundle creation must fail

log_filter_removes_biometric_terms.method: Input with 'embedding', 'score=', 'threshold', 'template', 'key material', 'path resolved' — all filtered out; 'daemon started', 'socket bound', 'ready for auth' preserved

long_hex_truncated.method: 64-char hex string → first 8 chars + '...', rest not present

model_sha256_redacted.method: Model SHA-256 ends with '...' — full hash not present in output

legacy_setuid_detected.method: Create namtor-worker-spawn file → detect_migration_artifacts returns artifact with kind='legacy-setuid'

legacy_install_script_detected.method: Create install.sh file → detect_migration_artifacts returns artifact with kind='legacy-install-script'

manual_install_detected.method: Create namtor-daemon without install-manifest.toml → detect_migration_artifacts returns artifact with kind='manual-install'

clean_install_no_artifacts.method: Create daemon + manifest (clean split install) → detect_migration_artifacts returns empty vec

migration_display_no_paths.method: MigrationArtifact Display output must not contain '/' (no file paths)

doctor_report_shows_migration.method: Full doctor report with legacy setuid present must contain 'migration:' and 'legacy-setuid'

all_three_detected.method: Create core+gnome+kde characteristic files → all three detected, manual=false

core_only_detected.method: Create only core files → core=true, gnome=false, kde=false

manual_install_detected.method: Create daemon without manifest → core=false, manual=true

no_forbidden_tokens_in_display.method: InstalledPackages Display output must not contain 'embedding', 'template', 'threshold', 'score', 'biometric', 'gate', 'raw', 'path', 'key'

backups_and_dotfiles_skipped.method: PAM files with .bak, ~, .hidden, .namtor.bak extensions are skipped

privacy_safe_display.method: ProtectionInfo Display must not contain 'key' or '/' (paths)
